test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

Yesterday, I went to the store and buy some groceries.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 2".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The erroneous part is the use of the present form of the verb **"buy"**.
 
• The verb **"went"** is in the **past tense**, indicating an action that occurred in the past.
 
• However, the verb** "buy" **is in the **present tense**, which doesn't agree with the past tense of **"went."**
 
• Hence, the erroneous part of the sentence is the use of verb **"buy"** instead of **"bought" **(Simple Past form).

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

**Correct Sentence**: "Yesterday, I went to the store and **bought**__ some groceries."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The verb** "buy"** means to obtain in exchange for payment.
 
• The simple past form of **"buy" **is **"bought"** and the past participle form is **"bought"**.
